Class LobbyController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.LobbyController
All Implemented Interfaces:
UserInterface
public class LobbyController extends Object implements UserInterface
JavaFX controller for LobbyScreen.fxml. Implements UserInterface so that incoming network DTOs drive the UI state machine. All UI updates from non-JavaFX threads use Platform.runLater().

CREATE flow: NICKNAME → NUM_PLAYERS → TOTEM_SELECTION (local) → buildLobbyCreate

JOIN flow: GAME_ID → NICKNAME → buildLobbyEnter → onTotemSelection → TOTEM_SELECTION → buildLobbySelectTotem
